metadata.description: GenLI3202's Claude desktop mods and skins, one marketplace. 一个市场装全部：星空远征皮肤、螃蟹搭子、cache-tax-confirm。

plugins.name: star-voyage
plugins.description: 星空远征：一艘飞往你定下那一天的飞船。星图巡航、打字拉近、发送后星际穿梭、闲置入港；竖排诗句；并行的对话显示为远征小队。 A Claude desktop skin: a ship flying toward a day you choose.

plugins.name: crab-pal
plugins.description: 螃蟹搭子：每个会话一只像素小螃蟹。看到其他会话和它们的子 agent，点一下就跳过去。 A pixel crab per session: see your other sessions and their subagents, click to jump.

plugins.name: cache-tax-confirm
plugins.description: cache-tax 的修改版：缓存冷了，发送被拦在一张「付费发送 / 放弃」卡片后面，并建议付费还是换新会话。 cache-tax patched: a cold send waits behind a Pay and send card. Do not install beside upstream cache-tax.
